# node_modules/mochijsnative

MochiBerry **native-first** engine-control module — the `context`/`value` API that
drives the engine from JS and C. v0.4.0, **65 exports**, verified by
`selftest/mochijsnative.js` (22 checks) + `selftest/mochijsnative_v04.js` (36 checks).

## ⚠️ Host requirement (the #1 gotcha)

The DLL resolves engine symbols (`MBJS_*`) from the **host image** at load time.
The host exe **must be linked with `-Wl,--export-all-symbols`** (JIT TUs pulled
in via `--whole-archive`), e.g.:

```
gcc -O2 -o build_manual/mbjs-host2.exe mbjs-cli.o mbjs-repl.o standalone.o \
    -Wl,--whole-archive libmbjs_hostapi.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive \
    -Wl,--export-all-symbols -lm -lpthread
```

Run the selftests with that host:

```
E:/bcf/mochiberry/build_manual/mbjs-host2.exe -m selftest/mochijsnative.js
E:/bcf/mochiberry/build_manual/mbjs-host2.exe -m selftest/mochijsnative_v04.js
```

If the host exports nothing, init fails with
`mbjs_call_module ... initialization error` — that means the ABI was not
exported, not that the DLL is missing. If the engine is a shared library
(`mbjs.dll` / `libmbjs.dll`), the resolver finds it automatically.

## Export groups (65)

- **meta**: version, abi, exportNames, exportSignature, hostBase, hostExport,
  engineVersion, lastError, handleStats, detectModule
- **runtime/context**: runtimeNew, runtimeFree, runtimeLimits, contextNew,
  contextFree, contextStd, getException, dumpError, await, loop, throwError,
  exceptionHas, memoryUsage
- **value**: valueNew, valueFree, valueType, valueIsException, valueToNumber,
  valueToInt, valueToString, valueJson, valueDup, valueToBool, valueEq,
  valueIsError, valueIsFunction, bigintNew
- **objects/properties/call**: newObject, newArray, getGlobal, getProp, setProp,
  propDefine, propHas, propDelete, propKeys, protoGet, protoSet, callValue,
  jsonParse, stringify, promiseNew
- **execution**: eval, evalModule
- **FFI**: bind, call, unbind
- **JIT**: jitNew, jitInfo, jitStats, jitCompile, jitInvoke, jitCall,
  jitCleanup, jitFree (graceful without a JIT backend)

## High-level JS API (deep.js)

`Runtime` / `Context` / `Value` / `Jit` wrap the raw handles, e.g.
`ctx.eval('40+2').toNumber()`, `ctx.set('g', v)`, `ctx.propDefine(o,'x',42)`,
`ctx.promise()`, `ctx.memoryUsage()`, `valueFromJS(ctx, 123n)` (full 64-bit
BigInt precision via `bigintNew`).

## Layout

- `native/mochijsnative.c` — canonical C source (mirrored into
  `mochi_modules/mochijsnative/native/`, `.modrepos/`, `.orgfix/`)
- `include/mochijsnative.h`, `include/mochijsnative_abi.h` — generated from the
  C export table
- `lib/mochijsnative_x86_64.dll` — built from the canonical source
- `index.js` / `deep.js` / `native.js` / `build.js` — JS wrappers

Maintained by the SEVM project.
